query:
INSERT INTO access.realm_rehomes (tenant_id, realm_id, version, from_domain, to_domain, from_pos, to_pos)
         SELECT $1, $2,
                COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM access.realm_rehomes
                           WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND realm_id = $2), 0) + 1,
                $3, $4, $5, $6
         RETURNING version
